source_policy.uncertainty_rule: Keep null when an exact same-instrument final cannot be independently verified. Never blend observations from different trade dates, sessions or futures contracts.
source_policy.cross_source_rule: If same-date sources disagree, keep the highest-authority exact series and mark validation_required; never substitute a different date or instrument.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Nvidia is in talks to anchor Anthropic's potential mega-IPO with an investment of up to $10 billion
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported Anthropic is considering an IPO that could raise as much as $100 billion at a valuation around $2 trillion, with Nvidia discussing an anchor investment of up to $10 billion.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Deepens Nvidia's strategic exposure to a major GPU customer and reinforces the circular-capital / compute-demand theme, while also increasing scrutiny of AI valuations and financing needs.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Larry Ellison cancels a planned sale of 50 million Oracle shares as Oracle prepares major AI-cloud financing
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Oracle said Ellison canceled the trading plan and sold no shares. Oracle is separately targeting roughly $45-$50 billion of 2026 debt-and-equity financing to expand cloud infrastructure for customers including AMD, Meta, Nvidia, OpenAI, TikTok and xAI.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: AI demand remains strong, but financing intensity and balance-sheet capacity are becoming as important as GPU availability.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: OpenAI says a 2026 IPO would be ill-advised amid rising AI-safety concerns
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Sam Altman said OpenAI does not plan to go public in 2026 and would prioritize safety and potentially slower development over a near-term listing.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: May cool near-term AI-IPO enthusiasm without materially reducing committed cloud and infrastructure spending; adds policy and safety risk premium to frontier-model companies.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: No new cash-market session on Saturday; Friday closes remain canonical
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Friday showed broad semiconductor recovery even as 10-year Treasury yields remained near 5%.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi Arabia temporarily shuts the East-West oil pipeline after a drone attack
breaking_news.summary: Reuters reported the 1,200-km pipeline, a key route bypassing the Strait of Hormuz with capacity around 5 million barrels per day, was temporarily shut after an aerial attack.
breaking_news.market_impact: Creates a fresh weekend gap-risk for crude, inflation expectations and global bond yields when markets reopen.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: A renewed oil spike would pressure Taiwan import costs, the TWD and valuation-sensitive growth/AI shares despite strong end-demand.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says Iran was probably responsible for the Saudi pipeline attack
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. president said Iran was probably behind the attack and confirmed discussions with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.
breaking_news.market_impact: Raises geopolitical risk premium into Monday trading even though Friday WTI settled lower at $100.05.

breaking_news.headline: Weekend markets are closed, so Friday's oil retreat does not incorporate the Saudi pipeline attack
breaking_news.summary: WTI's latest official settlement remains $100.05 on 2026-09-11, down 2.37% on the day but up roughly 9.4% for the week.
breaking_news.market_impact: Do not treat Friday settlement as a reaction to Saturday's pipeline news; Monday futures may reprice sharply.

earnings_summary.last_24h: No major U.S. mega-cap earnings were released during the Saturday window. The important new corporate-finance update is Oracle: Larry Ellison canceled a planned 50-million-share sale while the company continues a very large debt/equity funding program to finance AI-cloud expansion.
earnings_summary.guidance_watch: Oracle's Q1 AI-cloud demand and $664B backlog remain the key infrastructure read-through, but the weekend financing story shifts attention to capex funding, power availability and returns on invested capital. No new weekend guidance from Nvidia, AMD, TSMC, Apple or Microsoft.

narration_points: 今天是週日，沒有新的美股與台股現貨交易；所有行情嚴格沿用最新完成交易日2026年9月11日，不把週末新聞後的想像價格當成收盤價。
美股週五反彈：S&P 500收7656.98、漲0.86%；Nasdaq漲0.96%；Dow漲0.98%；Russell 2000漲0.45%，VIX官方收15.84、下跌11.21%。
市場雷達仍是高利率壓力：10年債殖利率收約4.974%，位於52週區間約98.3%；DXY收99.03；黃金12月期貨4408.90；WTI正式結算100.05美元。
半導體週五明顯回升：SOX官方收11824、漲1.81%；AMD 516.13、漲2.49%；TSM ADR 433.19、漲1.21%；NVIDIA 218.29、近乎持平。
週末最大新風險是沙烏地阿拉伯East-West輸油管遭無人機攻擊後暫停運作。這條管線可繞過荷莫茲海峽，容量約每日500萬桶，星期一油價存在重新跳空的風險。
因此要特別注意：WTI的100.05美元是星期五結算，尚未反映星期六的輸油管攻擊；不能把兩者混成同一時間點。
AI方面，Reuters報導NVIDIA正洽談最高100億美元成為Anthropic大型IPO的錨定投資人；Anthropic可能募資最高1000億美元、估值約2兆美元。
Oracle則出現新的AI資本支出融資訊號：Larry Ellison取消5000萬股出售計畫，但Oracle仍準備透過債券與股權籌措數百億美元擴充AI Cloud。
台股最新完成交易日仍是9月11日：TAIEX跌1.61%；近月台指期OI 88464口、外資淨空-85067口；歸屬9月14日session的週五夜盤反彈0.87%至46588，夜盤OI官方不發布。
本週真正決戰是9月16日FOMC。若週末能源風險把油價再推高，Fed與10年債壓力可能蓋過AI基本面；若油價受控，半導體週五的相對強勢有機會延續。
